strategy.offer: Integrated quality assurance, calibration, measurement devices, software, markers, training, and support services for radiation therapy and medical imaging.
strategy.customers: Healthcare professionals and clinical departments using radiation in therapy or imaging who need safe, efficient, compliant operations.
strategy.why_we_win: It argues connected, intuitive workflows, precise reliable measurements, and strong post-sale support reduce errors, downtime, and compliance burden while improving patient safety.
strategy.resources: It cites decades of dosimetry experience, accredited calibration capabilities, certified physicists and engineers, training programs, and worldwide service teams with round-the-clock support.
strategy.direction: Toward a unified, cloud-enabled QA platform connecting applications, users, devices, and data for broader visibility, benchmarking, and workflow control.
